scheme_name: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
other_conditions: Only State Livestock Agencies are eligible.
benefits_summary: One‑time grant‑in‑aid up to Rs 4 crore as central share (plus Rs 30 lakh for consumables), with a 60:40 funding pattern for most states and higher central share for NER, Himalayan states and UTs.
